scenes.say: The open house sign says 416,700 dollars. Only one question matters here.
That's the October median for an existing home, from the National Association of Realtors.
The typical full-time worker earns 1,232 dollars a week, or 64,064 a year.
Give housing 28 percent of that, at a 7.21 percent rate with 9 percent down.
After insurance, tax and mortgage insurance, the house tops out near 174,000 dollars.
That's 42 percent of the median price, from a perfectly ordinary paycheck.
So which salary actually reaches the sign? Five levels are in the full video on the channel.
